annotations.title: List your Sign in with Chain Daddy clients

description:
List your sign-in clients

The Sign in with Chain Daddy clients you registered as a developer, newest first, deleted ones left out. Each shows its redirect URIs, whether it is confidential (and the first characters of its secret), the token page it is bound to, which redirect hosts the consent screen marks Verified right now, and whether support has suspended it. The secret itself is never shown again after creation. Needs a developer account (403 `DEVELOPER_AGREEMENT_REQUIRED` without one), not current membership.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy (scope api:read).
name: list_oauth_clients

clientSecret.description: `cd_oauth_` + 64 hex. Only in the create response, and only for a confidential client.

secretPrefix.description: First characters of a confidential client's secret (`cd_oauth_` + 6)

suspended.description: Support turned the client off; it signs nobody in until support lifts it

verifiedHosts.description: Redirect hosts the consent screen marks Verified right now
